act.name: Registration Act, 1908
act.source_authority: Department of Land Resources, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing compulsory and optional registration of documents, presentation, refusal, appeals and legal effect.

sections.title: Time for presenting documents.
sections.text: Section 23 states the general time for presenting a document for registration.
sections.plain_language_summary: Except for a will and subject to statutory exceptions, a document must generally be presented for registration within four months of execution.
